what: In the middle of a full-screen panel, inside a vessel (wine glass·bottle outline svg), a wave (one 42px cycle flowing sideways over 1.6s) rises to the progress level and the number below climbs 0→100%, then the whole panel lifts away upward over 2.1s power4.inOut and fires fx:done. With a confirmation gate added, it rises to 10% over 2s, then the vessel vanishes over 1s (power2.inOut) and .5s later the gate floats up over 1s (meanwhile the number, hidden, climbs to 85% over 2.2s). Pressing Yes sets the gate over 1s, and .5s later the vessel returns, climbs 85→100% over 2s (power1.out), then lifts away. Given a key, that tab (sessionStorage) is not asked again — a Hero for alcohol·adult-verification brands

options.dur: Time in seconds to fill 0→100% without the door, default 2.4
options.first: Progress (%) at which to stop before the door, default 10
options.pause: Time in seconds to count up to first, default 2
options.resume: Progress (%) at which filling resumes after passing the door, default 85
options.out: Time for the panel to lift away upward (sec), default 2.1
options.fade: Seconds for the bowl and door to vanish and reappear, default 1
options.wait: Seconds until the door appears after the bowl vanishes, default .5
options.key: sessionStorage name used to remember the pass (if empty, asks every time)
options.[data-fx-part=center]: Cell holding a bowl and a number — disappears while the door opens
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Inner g clipped (clipPath) into a bowl shape — rises as far as the progress
options.[data-fx-part=wave]: Wave path inside fill (three times the container width, top edge rippling) — flows sideways
options.[data-fx-part=gate]: (If present) confirm door — inside it [data-fx-part=yes] button
options.--fx-rise: Distance the paint rises (svg unit px), default 80px
options.--fx-wave / --fx-wave-dur: Width and time of one wave cycle, default 42px·1.6s
options.fx:done: Once the panel has fully cleared, it fires from the attached element — hook the Hero entrance onto this
options.creep: Time (seconds, sine.inOut) the hidden state ramps up from first→resume while the gate is showing, default 2.2
